rationale.rules-based-checks: Deterministic AST allowlists, timeouts, and runtime controls block unsafe code.
rationale.remediation-gating: Safe-grammar enforcement filters autonomously regenerated fixes before execution.
rationale.framework: STELP is a reusable secure transpilation and execution pipeline architecture.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and benchmarked a working Python STELP prototype.
rationale.agentic: Targets headless agents producing executable code and action plans.
rationale.steering: Diagnostic feedback substantively guides the generating LLM's automatic rewrites.
rationale.risk-security: Evaluates mitigation against human-validated, CWE-labeled insecure generated code.
